text: I would rather make slightly wonky pancakes than perfectly identical ones.

text: I talk to the kettle while waiting for it to finish.

text: I keep the toaster setting exactly where it worked once.

text: I would use my nicest teapot on an entirely ordinary Tuesday.

text: I wash the mixing bowl before sitting down to eat.

text: I would make one enormous pancake instead of flipping six small ones.

text: I need a cup of something warm before I can discuss breakfast.
sceneSummary: A totem faces the teapot while the toaster quietly waits.

text: I would follow a recipe more carefully for a friend than for myself.
sceneSummary: A totem examines its bowl and spatula with unusual concentration.

text: I enjoy the sound of toast popping up enough to wait beside it.
sceneSummary: A totem watches the toaster closely while the kettle sits behind it.

text: I would host a pancake breakfast even if my table is too small.
sceneSummary: Several totems squeeze around pancakes and a teapot on a tiny table.

text: I put every ingredient in a separate little bowl before starting.
sceneSummary: A totem circles an orderly group of bowls beside the teapot.

text: I would use a spatula as a microphone while breakfast cooks.
sceneSummary: A totem holds its spatula like a microphone in front of the toaster.

text: I like a kitchen that looks as if someone has actually cooked in it.
sceneSummary: A bowl and toaster share a cheerfully busy workspace with a totem.

text: I would choose extra pancakes over an extra fancy tea service.
sceneSummary: A totem pulls the pancake stack close while the teapot stands aside.

text: I warm the teapot even when only I will notice.
sceneSummary: A totem brings the kettle carefully toward its waiting teapot.

text: I would keep a strange-looking spatula if it was excellent at flipping.
sceneSummary: A totem tests a crooked spatula underneath a pancake.

text: I measure pancake batter by confidence rather than by the markings.
sceneSummary: A totem tips an oversized bowl toward a small pancake stack.

text: I would rearrange the kitchen to give the toaster a better view.
sceneSummary: A totem moves the toaster to a prominent spot beside the teapot.

text: I prefer a long leisurely breakfast to a very impressive dinner.
sceneSummary: A relaxed totem wanders between warm pancakes and a kettle.

text: I would let a guest choose which teapot we use.
sceneSummary: A totem presents two kitchen vessels as a friendly choice.

text: I try to flip pancakes dramatically even when nobody is watching.
sceneSummary: A totem balances a pancake high above a theatrical spatula.

text: I leave the mixing bowl to soak as if soaking were a full chore.
sceneSummary: A totem leaves its bowl tucked behind the kettle and strolls away.

text: I would choose a compact toaster over a kitchen full of clever gadgets.
sceneSummary: A totem selects a simple toaster beside a crowded mixing bowl.

text: I believe a teapot cosy can have far more personality than necessary.
sceneSummary: A totem decorates a teapot cosy using a spatula as a tiny stand.

text: I would carry pancakes to the table one at a time to keep them warm.
sceneSummary: A totem carefully transports one pancake on a spatula.

text: I get more excited about a good mixing bowl than a complicated recipe.
sceneSummary: A totem hugs a mixing bowl while the teapot sits unchosen.

text: I like waiting for the kettle because it gives me a tiny official break.
sceneSummary: A resting totem sits with the kettle while the toaster stays busy.

text: I would rescue the first wonky pancake from being called a practice one.
sceneSummary: A totem shelters an imperfect pancake behind the toaster.

text: I keep a spare spatula for the person who suddenly wants to help.
sceneSummary: A totem offers a second spatula across a shared mixing bowl.

text: I keep the teapot on the table so nobody has to ask for a refill.
sceneSummary: A totem offers a table-side teapot while the ready kettle waits behind it.

text: I prefer an old reliable toaster to one with a screen full of choices.
sceneSummary: A totem studies a plain toaster next to a decorative teapot.

text: I tap the spatula on the bowl as if I am conducting breakfast.
sceneSummary: A totem conducts around a mixing bowl with its raised spatula.

text: I would build a pancake stack taller than the teapot just to see if I could.
sceneSummary: A pancake tower rises above the teapot as a totem steadies it.

text: I put the kettle on when I cannot decide what to do next.
sceneSummary: A thoughtful totem chooses the kettle over an unfinished mixing bowl.

text: I like cooking with someone who tidies while I make the mess.
sceneSummary: Two totems share a bowl while one gathers the spatula.

text: I would serve breakfast in the mixing bowl if it saved another dish.
sceneSummary: A totem carries pancakes to the table inside the mixing bowl.

text: I think the person making tea should get to choose the teapot.
sceneSummary: A totem offers the kettle handle to a friend choosing the teapot.

text: I would wait for properly crisp toast rather than rush breakfast.
sceneSummary: A totem sits patiently by the toaster beside ready pancakes.

text: I can make a meal feel special by changing where the teapot sits.
sceneSummary: A totem arranges the teapot as a centrepiece with the toaster tucked back.

text: I would rather learn one brilliant pancake recipe than ten acceptable ones.
sceneSummary: A totem studies a single pancake above its well-used mixing bowl.

text: I give the spatula a little victory wave after a successful flip.
sceneSummary: A totem waves the spatula beside a kettle like a tiny victory flag.

text: I would use the last clean bowl for batter and deal with breakfast later.
sceneSummary: A totem commits its final bowl to batter while the toaster waits.

text: I like my breakfast warm enough that conversation can wait a minute.
sceneSummary: A totem brings a warm kettle beside fresh pancakes before friends gather.

text: I would happily eat pancakes for a second meal on the same day.
sceneSummary: A totem returns to pancakes while leaving the toaster unused.

text: I line up cups before making tea as if a tiny audience is arriving.
sceneSummary: A totem builds a neat tea setting beside a large serving bowl.

text: I would name a kitchen gadget after it had saved breakfast twice.
sceneSummary: A totem ceremoniously presents its toaster with a spatula as a banner.

text: I keep mixing after the batter is ready because the motion is satisfying.
sceneSummary: A totem circles its spatula through a bowl of already smooth batter.

text: I would lend my favourite kettle only to someone who brings it back with a story.
sceneSummary: Two totems share a kettle across a teapot set for a long conversation.

text: I enjoy carrying a breakfast tray like I run a tiny hotel.
sceneSummary: A totem carries a proud tray with a teapot and pancake stack.

text: I would set out the breakfast things at night to impress my sleepy future self.
